enunciado: Create the class Ticket where each object receives a consecutive id taken from a shared static counter. Add a static method created() that tells how many tickets exist. Create three tickets and show their ids and the total.
objetivos: Tell instance attributes from class attributes
pistas: A static attribute exists only once, shared by all objects.
In the constructor: this.id = Ticket.nextId and then increment.
A static method cannot use this.
